description: Audit whether the search and atlas are overfitting Exoo-like or cyclic families by forcing alternative seed sources. The goal is not a new construction per se, but a robust negative control for novelty claims.
mathematical_formalization: Partition seed families by provenance P and require obstruction/core statistics to remain stable under changes in P.
implementation_hypothesis: Mix Exoo-derived, asymmetric perturbative, and cyclic/design-theoretic seeds before mining obstruction recurrence.
experiment_seed: Compare atlas statistics under Exoo-only parents versus diversified parents.

closest_prior_art.title: Study of Exoo's Lower Bound for Ramsey number R(5,5)
Can genetic algorithms with the symmetric heuristic find the Ramsey number R(5,5)

novelty_claim: A stability audit prevents the main H1 object from being a disguised Exoo memorizer.
differentiation: This is a falsification control, not a claim of a new lower bound family by itself.
